name: Magpie

revision.note: Rewritten from the human-performer reading to a photoreal CGI animal.

rendering.rule: bible/cultivation.json SUP-002 (amended BIB-0027); member of FAC-caucus-race-company (no uniform)
rendering.limits: Bird anatomy throughout; speech by beak movement. No clothing or accessory of any kind at any point (BIB-0029 arbitration; costumes.json COS-027); no cartoon face.

gender_note.reason: The source says only 'one old Magpie' ('it'). A fussy old hypochondriac muffling his throat against the night air; male balances the party.

base_age_note.reason: 'Old' is sourced; persona band kept for voice casting. As an animal: an old bird with frayed, worn tail feathers and a slightly dulled gloss.

hair.color: black head, breast and back with a blue-green and violet gloss; white belly and white wing patches; long graduated black tail with a green sheen
hair.style: neat but worn: the long tail feathers frayed at the tips; damp on the bank
hair.reason: Species plumage; wear marks carry the sourced age.

build.height_note: Perched height; total length 44-46 cm of which about half is tail, species-true.
build.posture: slightly hunched against the night air; precise, fussy movements as he wraps himself up
build.scale_reference: On the bank with the shrunken Alice (SUP-003); mid-sized in the party, the long tail making him read larger.
build.quote: began wrapping itself up very carefully
build.reason: Species-true size; the wrapping-up is sourced.

entry_state.state: on the bank with the party, still damp from the pool
entry_state.quote: all dripping wet, cross, and uncomfortable

marks.description: no garment: at his exit he "wraps himself up" by fluffing his throat feathers out into a thick ruff, drawing his head down into them and hunching his shoulder plumage up round the throat before he flies off
marks.quote: began wrapping itself up very carefully, remarking, “I really must be getting home; the night-air doesn’t suit my throat!”
marks.reason: The wrapping-up and the throat are sourced and are kept in full as performance. The dark grey knitted muffler that used to carry them was an inferred garment, not a text-named one, so it is removed under BIB-0027 / SUP-002 (a talking animal wears only garments the text names) and to agree with costumes.json COS-027 and the H2-locked sheet, which show a bare fluffed throat. The rejected muffler design is preserved with its source anchor in costumes.json COS-027.rejected_design so it can be restored by user ruling. Arbitration: DEF-p4-char-concept-201-a, changelog BIB-0029.

default_outfit_tone.summary: bare magpie throughout; no garment, scarf or accessory at any point, including the exit beat
default_outfit_tone.reason: Per SUP-002 (BIB-0027) only text-NAMED garments are worn; the old frock coat and watch-chain were dropped there, and the inferred exit muffler is dropped here (BIB-0029, DEF-p4-char-concept-201-a) so this card and costumes.json COS-027 no longer disagree. The sourced wrapping-up action survives as the fluffed-throat exit business in marks[0].

prompt_base_en: photoreal old Eurasian magpie, glossy black plumage with blue-green sheen, white belly and wing patches, long frayed graduated tail, strong black beak, beady dark eye, damp, throat feathers fluffed out into a thick ruff with its head drawn down into them against the night air, on a muddy pool bank at dusk, no clothing or scarf of any kind, natural bird anatomy, live-action film plate
